svg.aria-label: ArcMD bookmarks: the pointer moves to a paragraph, adds two bookmarks, jumps smoothly from the outline, and opens all bookmarks with Shift Command D.

g.text: A page for the lines I want to come back to.
Slow down. Notice the little things.
Some ideas deserve more than a passing glance.
Read a little. Think a little. Leave a little space.
Write down the thought you want to keep.
You can always find your way back to this line.
Save a line that surprised you
